method: All nine accepted V13 endpoints remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Forty-eight authored transition frames were generated as separate high-quality gpt-image-2 edits: the two adjacent V13 endpoints are authoritative for Sid and the matching dahbiahmed.com transition is authoritative only for pose and motion progress. The accepted right-to-bottom-right edge uses a stricter exact-pose redo selected after side-by-side QA.

constraints.uniformResize: Generated 1280x1280 chroma-key transition sources were uniformly normalized to 240x240 runtime-source cells; accepted endpoints remain 1254x1254 lossless masters and are uniformly downsampled only while building the 240px atlas cells.

alphaExtraction.fullyTransparentRgb: zeroed before 240px lossy WebP with alpha encoding

inputs: prior V13 left endpoint: edit target for framing, scale, crop, shoulders, wardrobe, and horizontal pose correction
top-left.webp: fixed hair-only reference for crown height, width, side fullness, texture, and identity
center.webp: supporting identity, lighting, and wardrobe reference

regeneratedEndpoints.alignment: border-key normalized the 1280x1280 generated source to 1254x1254, retained that scale, and applied only a rigid 12-pixel-left and 5-pixel-down canvas translation; no rescaling, anisotropic warp, compositing, or content regeneration
inputs: top-right.webp: fixed accepted reference with equal authority for identity, camera distance, face/head scale, hair, body framing, clothing construction, lighting, placement, and crop
bottom-right.webp: fixed accepted reference with equal authority for identity, camera distance, face/head scale, hair, body framing, clothing construction, lighting, placement, and crop
regeneratedEndpoints.postGenerationQa: left.webp was visually compared only for opposite-direction yaw magnitude and was not sent to the Image API; candidate 1 was rejected for reading down-right and candidate 2 for reading too frontal, while candidate 3 was selected for level pitch, clear rightward yaw, and reference-matched framing

graph.reversePlayback: same authored frames in reverse order

transitionSet.offlineMasters: 1280x1280 PNG generation outputs are retained outside the deployed runtime asset directory for future edits.
